_comment: Unified server config for Paws & Parcels. Copy this file to `server_config.json`, fill in the secret values (db.password, auth.jwtSecret, ashatHub.sharedSecret), and edit anything else you need. `server_config.json` is gitignored — never commit it.

ashatHub._comment_baseUrl: Base URL of the Ashat Hub install that authenticates Paws players. Examples: https://agpstudios.org, https://ashatos.byethost7.com.
ashatHub._comment_sharedSecret: Server-to-server trust secret. Must match PAWS_SHARED_SECRET in Ashat Hub's config/server_config.json exactly. Generate 32+ chars random.
ashatHub._comment_callbackUrl: Public URL of THIS game's 'Sign in' callback handler — Ashat Hub redirects the popup here after successful login. In dev: http://localhost:5173/api/auth/sso/callback (served by Vite proxy or static client). In prod: https://game.example.com/api/auth/sso/callback.
